import datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, stat, sys
packet_path = pathlib.Path("/workspace/scratch/c714f5bce554/continuation-checkpoints-20261116/post-transport-authoring/source-free-staging-transfer.json")
expected_packet = {"bytes":9502989,"sha256":"847ae52d5899ad21f03d93f54eb23b1d3a390884d95c24ef449d9d0c3730822c","gitBlob":"5283bce1aafe719e564a493a2526601cbe87ee0e"}
receipt_path = pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/c714f5bce554/continuation-checkpoints-20261116/post-transport-recovery-staging-receipt-20261117.json')
def ident(data):
    return {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'gitBlob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()}
def meta(info):
    return {'device': info.st_dev, 'inode': info.st_ino, 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode), 'uid': info.st_uid, 'gid': info.st_gid}
def stable_read(path):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode)
        with os.fdopen(os.dup(fd), 'rb') as stream:
            data = stream.read()
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        assert (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ctime_ns) == (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns)
        return data
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
receipt = {'kind': 'post-transport-recovery-exclusive-source-free-staging', 'startedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'attempt': 1, 'completed': False, 'sourceWrites': 0, 'testRematerialization': False, 'targetRuntimeEvaluated': False, 'oldPhysicalContinuityRecovered': False, 'oldCleanupQualified': False, 'directoriesCreated': [], 'filesWritten': [], 'fullReadbacks': [], 'error': None}
fds = []
exit_code = 2
try:
    assert not os.path.lexists(receipt_path), 'staging receipt already exists'
    raw = stable_read(packet_path)
    assert ident(raw) == expected_packet, 'transfer packet identity'
    packet = json.loads(raw)
    receipt['transferPacket'] = {'path': str(packet_path), **ident(raw), 'kind': 'local transfer data; payload identities retained in published R1 and original blobs/containers'}
    receipt['publicationGate'] = packet['publicationGate']
    assert packet['publicationGate']['commit'] == '1eff2aef92a5952618cb600604160c3a3024b2dd'
    assert packet['publicationGate']['rootFullReadIndependent'] is True and packet['publicationGate']['independentFullReadRoot'] is True
    scope = pathlib.Path(packet['scopeRoot'])
    controls = pathlib.Path(packet['controlRoot'])
    replicas = pathlib.Path(packet['replicaRoot'])
    evidence = pathlib.Path(packet['evidenceRoot'])
    assert scope == pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/c714-post-transport-20261117')
    assert controls == scope / 'controls' and replicas == scope / 'replicas' and evidence == scope / 'evidence'
    selected = []
    for row in packet['controls']:
        data = stable_read(pathlib.Path(row['sourcePath']))
        assert ident(data) == row['identity']
        selected.append((row, data, 'controls'))
    assert len(selected) == 2 and [row['role'] for row, _data, _kind in selected] == ['activeRunner', 'activeBinding']
    cfg = json.loads(selected[1][1])
    assert cfg['runnerIdentity'] == selected[0][0]['identity'] == packet['publicationGate']['runner']
    assert selected[1][0]['identity'] == packet['publicationGate']['binding']
    assert cfg['runnerLocalPath'] == selected[0][0]['path'] and cfg['bindingLocalPath'] == selected[1][0]['path']
    r1 = json.loads(cfg['combinedR1Body'])
    assert ident(cfg['combinedR1Body'].encode()) == packet['publicationGate']['r1']
    assert r1['execution']['scopeRoot'] == str(scope) and r1['execution']['controlRoot'] == str(controls)
    assert r1['execution']['replicaRoot'] == str(replicas) and r1['execution']['outputRoot'] == str(evidence)
    assert len(packet['replicas']) == len(r1['dataReplicaRecovery']['replicas']) == 6
    for row, original in zip(packet['replicas'], r1['dataReplicaRecovery']['replicas']):
        assert {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key not in ['body', 'containerRead']} == original
        data = row['body'].encode()
        assert ident(data) == row['identity']
        if row['source']['kind'] == 'complete-retained-container-member':
            assert row['containerRead'] == row['source']['container']
        selected.append((row, data, 'replicas'))
    assert len(selected) == 8 and len({row['path'] for row, _data, _kind in selected}) == 8
    assert sum(len(data) for _row, data, _kind in selected) == 15167305
    assert all(pathlib.Path(row['path']).parent == (controls if kind == 'controls' else replicas) for row, _data, kind in selected)
    receipt['allEightBodiesFullyReadAndVerifiedBeforeSelectedWrites'] = True
    receipt['selectedPayloadBytes'] = 15167305
    receipt['preWritePaths'] = [{'path': str(path), 'lexists': os.path.lexists(path)} for path in [scope, controls, replicas, evidence]]
    assert all(not row['lexists'] for row in receipt['preWritePaths'])
    parent = scope.parent
    assert parent.is_dir() and not parent.is_symlink() and parent.resolve() == parent
    parent_fd = os.open(parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    fds.append(parent_fd)
    os.mkdir(scope.name, mode=0o700, dir_fd=parent_fd)
    scope_fd = os.open(scope.name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent_fd)
    fds.append(scope_fd)
    scope_info = os.fstat(scope_fd)
    assert stat.S_ISDIR(scope_info.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(scope_info.st_mode) == 0o700 and scope_info.st_uid == os.getuid()
    receipt['directoriesCreated'].append({'path': str(scope), **meta(scope_info)})
    directory_fds = {}
    for name in ['controls', 'replicas']:
        os.mkdir(name, mode=0o700, dir_fd=scope_fd)
        directory_fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=scope_fd)
        fds.append(directory_fd)
        info = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        assert stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o700 and info.st_uid == os.getuid()
        directory_fds[name] = directory_fd
        receipt['directoriesCreated'].append({'path': str(scope / name), **meta(info)})
    for row, data, kind in selected:
        name = pathlib.Path(row['path']).name
        fd = os.open(name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, dir_fd=directory_fds[kind])
        try:
            with os.fdopen(os.dup(fd), 'wb') as stream:
                stream.write(data)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            info = os.fstat(fd)
            assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o600 and info.st_uid == os.getuid() and info.st_nlink == 1
            receipt['filesWritten'].append({'role': row['role'], 'path': row['path'], **meta(info), **ident(data)})
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        readback = stable_read(pathlib.Path(row['path']))
        assert readback == data and ident(readback) == row['identity']
        after = pathlib.Path(row['path']).lstat()
        assert stat.S_ISREG(after.st_mode) and stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode) == 0o600 and after.st_uid == os.getuid()
        assert (after.st_dev, after.st_ino) == (info.st_dev, info.st_ino)
        receipt['fullReadbacks'].append({'role': row['role'], 'path': row['path'], **meta(after), **ident(readback)})
    assert sorted(os.listdir(scope_fd)) == ['controls', 'replicas']
    assert sorted(os.listdir(directory_fds['controls'])) == ['combined-runner.py', 'red-binding.json']
    assert sorted(os.listdir(directory_fds['replicas'])) == sorted(pathlib.Path(row['path']).name for row in packet['replicas'])
    receipt['evidenceRootAbsent'] = not os.path.lexists(evidence)
    assert receipt['evidenceRootAbsent']
    receipt['completed'] = True
    exit_code = 0
except BaseException as error:
    receipt['error'] = type(error).__name__ + ': ' + str(error)
finally:
    for fd in reversed(fds):
        os.close(fd)
    receipt['finishedAt'] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    receipt['exitCode'] = exit_code
    receipt['qualification'] = 'Exact new source-free files and point-in-time ownership only. No target execution, fresh whole runtime boundary, old inode/process continuity or old cleanup qualification.'
    receipt_data = (json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n').encode()
    fd = os.open(receipt_path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
        stream.write(receipt_data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    assert stable_read(receipt_path) == receipt_data
    print(json.dumps({'receipt': {'path': str(receipt_path), **ident(receipt_data)}, 'result': receipt}))
sys.exit(exit_code)
